text:
maria: Heads-up — planning a prod cutover for model-cache refresh v2 at 16:00 PT today (≈ 23:00 UTC). Need owners for smoke + rollback sign-offs. Window ~30m. I'll post runbook link and checklist.

jon: I can own smoke tests (gen, embeddings, latency sweep). @maria what's the canary %?

maria: Canary 5% on dedicated pool, then ramp to 100% if green. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/prod-cache-refresh (short checklist in thread).

sam: I'll be on rollback standby. Confirming previous image pinned — image: inference:v2.1-rev3. Rollback steps in runbook.

tina: I'll watch logs/traces and set latency alerts. Will call rollback if 95p > 500ms for 2m or error rate > 1%.

ops-sre-bot: Scheduled deploy window reserved by @maria: 2026-04-01T23:00:00Z -> 30m. Reminder set for 15m before.

maria: Quick checklist for this cutover:
- [ ] canary deployed (5%)
- [ ] smoke tests pass (gen / emb / latency)
- [ ] metrics baseline verified (errors, p95, cpu/gpu)
- [ ] rollback dry-run verified
- [ ] post-deploy alerting + dashboard up
Assigning: smoke=@jon rollback=@sam logs=@tina oncall=@ryan

jon: Acknowledged. I'll run a small harness and latency sweep, then report results. Example commands I'll run:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
run_spike_test --target qps=10 --duration=60
```

sam: Rollback dry-run completed in staging. Commands I have ready:
```
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/inference-runtime --to-revision=2
kubectl apply -f k8s/old-config.yaml
```
I can execute rollback if needed; will coordinate via phone.

ryan: Quick Q — is there any DB schema or migration included?

maria: No DB changes — this is KV/cache invalidation and a model artifact swap. Ops awareness only.

ryan: Ok, I'll be oncall and watching infra metrics for the window. If GPU throttling or disk IO spikes, I'll escalate.

tina: I'll spin up a short dashboard and a flamegraph link; will watch p95 and error-rate. If threshold breached twice in a row, I'll call rollback.

jon: Plan: start canary @16:00 PT, run smoke 5m, if green I'll thumbs-up and ramp to 100% over 10m.

maria: Final approvals needed from owners — please react with :white_check_mark: in thread when ready: smoke=@jon rollback=@sam monitor=@tina oncall=@ryan

jon: :white_check_mark: smoke owner

sam: :white_check_mark: rollback ready

tina: :white_check_mark: monitoring in place

ryan: :white_check_mark: oncall ready

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled in 10 minutes. Start window: 2026-04-01T22:50:00Z (automated reminder will follow).

maria: Great — starting canary at 16:00 PT. I'll post live status updates here. Keep phones open for rollback pings.
